    AI Overview
    The 2026 Kentucky Derby (152nd running) is scheduled for Saturday, May 2, 2026, at Churchill Downs in Louisville, KY, with Derby Week events starting April 25. Commandment, trained by Brad Cox, secured a spot by winning the Florida Derby, while Paladin is noted as an early 6-1 favorite. Official tickets and travel packages are currently available. 
    Watch the exciting finish of the 2026 Florida Derby, a key prep race for the Kentucky Derby:
    1m
    NBC Sports
    YouTube• Mar 28, 2026
    Key Details for the 2026 Kentucky Derby: 
    • Main Race: Saturday, May 2, 2026.
    • Location: Churchill Downs, Louisville, KY.
    • Gates Open: 9:00 a.m. ET (First race: 11:00 a.m. ET).
    • Key Prep Races & Contenders: Commandment won the Florida Derby, while other top contenders include Paladin, The Puma, Emerging Market, Fulleffort, and Pavlovian.
    • Events: Derby Week features daily themed racing, including the Kentucky Oaks on May 1st, where attendees are encouraged to wear pink to support women's health. 
    Tickets and Accommodations: 
    • Packages: Official ticket packages, including premium dining and hospitality, are offered through Derby Experiences.
    • Options: Offerings include Club SI (first-floor paddock), Homestretch Club, and various Clubhouse/Grandstand seating.
    • Hotels: Packages involving hotels like the Brown Hotel or Embassy Suites Lexington are available through Sports Traveler. 
    As of late March 2026, the field is taking shape through the final "Championship Season" of prep races, with 100-point winners guaranteed a spot in the 20-horse field.

    AI Overview
    The 2026 Kentucky Derby, held on May 2nd, centers on long-standing, iconic traditions: wearing extravagant hats, drinking mint juleps, eating Hot Browns and Derby-Pie, and singing "My Old Kentucky Home". Other key rituals include the Garland of Roses for the winner, "Run for the Roses" theme, and a 'Pink Out' on Oaks Day. 
    Key 2026 Traditions & Usage Examples
    • Fashionable Headwear: Spectators wear elaborate, colorful hats to showcase style. 
    • Official Drink: Drinking traditional Mint Juleps—bourbon, sugar, and mint—served in official glasses. 
    • Culinary Classics: Eating hot brown sandwiches (turkey, bacon, mornay sauce) and pecan-chocolate Derby-Pie. 
    • Ceremonial Song: Singing "My Old Kentucky Home" during the post-parade, honoring state history. 
    • Winning Garland: The victor is draped with a Garland of Roses. 
    • Oaks Day "Pink Out": On Friday (May 1), fans wear pink to support breast cancer awareness. 
    • Pre-race Rituals: Watching horses in "Dawn at the Downs" workouts. 
    Synonyms/Related Terms 
    • "The Run for the Roses" (The race itself)
    • "The Most Exciting Two Minutes in Sports" (The race duration)
    • "Lilies for the Fillies" (The Kentucky Oaks trophy garland)
    • "Derby Festival" (Leading community events)
    • "Churchill Downs" (The venue)
    2026 Specific Events
    • Fillies Derby Ball: March 28, 2026, marks the start of the season. 
    • Opening Night/Thurby: Celebratory, high-society weekend events. 
    • Superstitions: Avoiding wearing green or carrying $50 bills, which are considered unlucky at the track.

        AI Overview
        Kentucky Derby 2026 tickets are currently on sale, with prices varying heavily by seat location and day. General admission to the infield starts around \$136–\$196, while two-day reserved seating packages start around \$779. Premium seating options, such as Clubhouse box seats and dining packages, can range from \$1,350 to over \$10,000+ per seat. 
        Key 2026 Ticket Pricing Tiers (As of early 2026):
        • Infield General Admission: ~$136–\$196 (access to infield only, includes programs) 
        • Frontside Standing Room: ~$731+ 
        • Reserved Seating: $779+ for two-day packages 
        • Clubhouse Box Seats: ~$1,350–\$4,500+ (often include food/drinks) 
        • Premium/VIP Packages: $10,000+ (Millionaires Row/Turf Club) 
        Important Purchasing Details:
        • Two-Day Tickets:
          Most reserved seating options are sold as two-day packages (Oaks and Derby). 
        • Prices Increase:
          Prices vary from official, third-party, and resale sites; early purchase is recommended. 
        • 502'sDay:
          Special general admission tickets may be available for \$5 during Derby Week, as reported by The Courier-Journal. 
        Prices are subject to change, and inventory changes rapidly, say The Courier-Journal and Kentucky Derby.

          AI Overview
          As of late March 2026, early betting favorites for the 2026 Kentucky Derby include Paladin (approx. 6-1 to 9-1), Chief Wallabee (8-1 to 11-1), and Nearly (9-1 to 10-1). These odds are futures, which fluctuate heavily based on spring prep races and betting activity before the May 2, 2026, race day, notes the Courier-Journal. 
          Top 2026 Kentucky Derby Futures Odds (As of March 2026): 
          • Paladin: 6-1 to 9-1
          • Chief Wallabee: 8-1 to 11-1
          • Nearly: 9-1 to 12-1
          • Renegade: 12-1 to 16-1
          • Commandment: 5-2 to 30-1 (Varies significantly by source)
          • Canaletto: 15-1
          Key Details
          • Top Contender Movement:
            Barnes and Colloquial have seen significant betting action, emerging as strong contenders. 
          • Key Prep Races:
            Performances in the Florida Derby and other late-March/early-April stakes are dramatically shifting odds for horses like Chief Wallabee and Commandment, notes Horse Racing Nation. 
          • "All Others" Bet:
            Betting on the field (any 3-year-old not listed individually) is often available, offering competitive odds, says SportsLine. 
          Official, final odds will be established through the pari-mutuel system following the post position draw during Derby week, explains FanDuel.

              What date is the Kentucky Derby in 2026?
              May 2, 2026
